_comment: Permanent traits bought with Resolve. Deliberately modest — the real progression is unlocking movements and clearing chapters, not stacking multipliers.

upgrades.name: Refinery
upgrades.desc: Grit converts to Resolve 15% better, per level.

upgrades.name: Salvage
upgrades.desc: Keep +10% more Grit when the loop resets, per level.

upgrades.name: Wanderer
upgrades.desc: One extra side node rolls in every area, per level.

upgrades.name: Long Hours
upgrades.desc: +4 hours on every deadline, per level.

upgrades.name: Kindness To Yourself
upgrades.desc: Scaling a movement down keeps +15% more Grit, per level.

upgrades.name: Open Ear
upgrades.desc: Echoes surface 40% more often, per level.

upgrades.name: Steady
upgrades.desc: Streak bonus grows 2% faster per day, per level.
